DesFirst.SourceString: 很惊讶么，客人？蝴蝶偶尔也会来咖啡厅舒展羽翼~
DesFirst.LocalizedString: Surprised, are you? Even butterflies like to spread their wings at the café occasionally.

DesSecond.SourceString: 想知道我为你准备了什么吗？亲自入局吧，你可是一枚出奇致胜的关键棋子。
DesSecond.LocalizedString: Curious about what I've prepared for you? Step into the game—you're the key piece that could turn the tide.

DesThird.SourceString: 引航者，我唯一可以透露的是，你现在很安全，没有人会打扰我们的对弈……呵呵，还想知道更多吗？
DesThird.LocalizedString: Navigator, the only thing I can reveal is that you're safe now. No one will disturb our little game... Heh, curious for more, are you?

EndDesOne.SourceString: 不必着急，游戏如同对弈，每一步都需经营筹划，在实战之前我可以陪你演习几局。
EndDesOne.LocalizedString: No need to rush. The game is like a chess match; every move requires careful planning. I can walk you through a few practice rounds before the real challenge begins.

EndDesTwo.SourceString: 真可惜，只差关键的一步了……喝杯咖啡休憩片刻吧，我可以给你一点提示喔。
EndDesTwo.LocalizedString: Shame. You were so close... Take a break. Have a cup of coffee. I can offer you a hint if you'd like.

EndDesThree.SourceString: 如我所想，你也是一名出色的棋手……既然如此，我就稍微透露一点点秘密给你吧，作为获胜的奖励。
EndDesThree.LocalizedString: As expected, you're truly exceptional... In that case, I'll tell you a little secret as a reward.

GameOpen.SourceString: 呵呵，不要紧张，玩个小游戏放松一下吧~这盘迷局，你能看得清吗？
GameOpen.LocalizedString: Heh, no need to be nervous. Let's unwind with a little game. Can you see through this puzzle?

DesFirst.SourceString: 噢，我的身份？……对，我只是一个对记录感兴趣的……执事而已。
DesFirst.LocalizedString: Oh, my identity? ... Indeed, I'm merely a butler with a keen interest in keeping records.

DesSecond.SourceString: 记录，思考，还有推论，对于我来说，如同呼吸一样，是自发的，也是必要的。
DesSecond.LocalizedString: Record, think, deduct. To me, these are as natural and vital as breathing.

DesThird.SourceString: 对，我正在记录。不用在意，如实地记录咖啡厅的一切，也是我的工作。
DesThird.LocalizedString: Yes, I'm recording. Don't mind me; faithfully recording everything in the café is simply part of my job.

EndDesOne.SourceString: 低头，还有叹气……这是沮丧的表现……对，在我的记录中，咖啡有助于提高你的对局胜率，那么要来一杯咖啡么？
EndDesOne.LocalizedString: Head lowered, sighing... Classic signs of frustration... According to my records, coffee can boost your odds of victory. Care for a cup?

EndDesTwo.SourceString: 值得称赞，你解出了多数谜题……但我很好奇，解开所有谜题时你会是什么样的反应。
EndDesTwo.LocalizedString: Commendable. You've solved most of the puzzles... But I'm intrigued—how will you react when you've unraveled them all?

EndDesThree.SourceString: 十分完美，无可挑剔的推论过程……对，我还有很多想要记录的东西，客人，你本身就是一个无比有趣的谜题。
EndDesThree.LocalizedString: Flawless... A deduction process beyond reproach... Indeed, I have much to record still. You, for one, are a most fascinating puzzle.

GameOpen.SourceString: 你在对局中的情绪波动与动作反应，也是我想记录的内容……对，开始挑战吧，我会做好记录。
GameOpen.LocalizedString: Your emotional shifts and physical reactions during the game are among the things I wish to record... Begin the challenge, and I'll ensure everything is documented meticulously.

DesFirst.SourceString: 不要担心，如果你在挑战时犯困或分神了，我会用枪声提醒你的。
DesFirst.LocalizedString: Don't worry. If you get sleepy or distracted during the challenge, I'll wake you up with a gunshot.

DesSecond.SourceString: 女仆的职责与工作……？我懂，清洁垃圾而已，我上手很快。
DesSecond.LocalizedString: Duties of a maid...? Got it. Cleaning and picking up trash. I'll get the hang of it quickly.

DesThird.SourceString: 客人，如果下次还迟到的话……你可以试想一下，那些尘垢的下场……
DesThird.LocalizedString: If you're late again... just imagine the fate of all that dust and dirt…

EndDesOne.SourceString: 污垢尚未被清除……客人，你需要女仆的特训，我来从头教你清洁的技巧吧。
EndDesOne.LocalizedString: The dirt hasn't been cleaned yet... You need some special maid training. Let me teach you the art of cleaning from scratch.

EndDesTwo.SourceString: 还算不错的结果，客人。下回，我们一起把剩余的污垢一扫而光吧。
EndDesTwo.LocalizedString: Not bad. Next time, let's clean the remaining dirt together.

EndDesThree.SourceString: 大扫除顺利完成。想要一些奖励？我不太懂，用子弹可以么？
EndDesThree.LocalizedString: The deep clean is done. Rewards, you say? I don't know. Will bullets do?

GameOpen.SourceString: 武器都被没收了，真没办法。来点基础一些的挑战吧。
GameOpen.LocalizedString: Bummer. My weapons have been confiscated. How about a basic challenge instead?
